g.title: G
cluster_micro
cluster_meso
cluster_macro

p4_micro_silent_infectious_flag → p4_macro_detection_coverage_rate upward A larger silent infectious pool lowers the number of new diagnoses per infectious person-step, reducing observed detection coverage.

p4_micro_silent_infectious_flag → p4_macro_masking_ratio upward Silent infectious episodes accumulate undiagnosed ever-exposed agents, increasing the ratio of never-diagnosed to ever-diagnosed infections.

p4_micro_symptomatic_undiagnosed_flag → p4_micro_silent_infectious_duration intra_scale Undiagnosed symptomatic infection plausibly extends the time an agent remains silently infectious because recognition is delayed.

p4_meso_group_silent_share → p4_micro_silent_infectious_flag downward A higher silent share within a quarantine-status group can reflect weaker detection and behavioural visibility in that group, increasing the likelihood that a currently infectious group member remains undiagnosed and therefore silent.

p4_meso_group_exposure_yield_silent → p4_meso_group_silent_share intra_scale Groups that generate more exposures per silent infectious person-step can sustain a larger silent share of infectious person-steps.

p4_meso_group_exposure_yield_silent → p4_macro_silent_prevalence_share upward Quarantine-status groups that generate more exposures per silent infectious person-step expand the silent infectious pool, increasing silent prevalence share.

p4_macro_detection_coverage_rate → p4_micro_silent_infectious_flag downward Higher detection coverage shortens the undiagnosed infectious period by finding cases sooner, reducing the probability that an infectious agent is silent (infectious but undiagnosed) at a sampled step.

p4_macro_detection_coverage_rate → p4_micro_symptomatic_undiagnosed_flag downward Increased detection coverage identifies symptomatic cases more quickly, lowering the chance that a symptomatic agent remains undiagnosed.

p4_macro_detection_coverage_rate → p4_meso_group_silent_share downward Higher detection coverage reduces the fraction of infectious person-steps that are undiagnosed within quarantine-status groups, because more infections are diagnosed.

p4_macro_detection_coverage_rate → p4_macro_silent_prevalence_share intra_scale Higher detection coverage moves infectious agents out of the undiagnosed pool, reducing the silent share of current infectious agents.
p4_macro_silent_prevalence_share → p4_macro_detection_coverage_rate intra_scale When more infectious agents are undiagnosed, new diagnoses per infectious person-step plausibly fall.
p4_macro_silent_prevalence_share → p4_macro_masking_ratio intra_scale A persistently large silent infectious share plausibly accumulates more never-diagnosed relative to ever-diagnosed infections.
p4_macro_silent_prevalence_share → p4_macro_symptom_to_diagnosis_lag intra_scale A high silent share plausibly lengthens recorded symptom-to-diagnosis intervals because recognition is delayed.

p4_macro_masking_ratio → p4_meso_group_silent_share downward A large accumulated pool of never-diagnosed ever-exposed agents can feed back into group-level silent infectious activity by sustaining undetected transmission within quarantine-status groups.

p4_macro_symptom_to_diagnosis_lag → p4_micro_silent_infectious_duration downward A longer population-average symptom-to-diagnosis interval implies diagnosis occurs later in the disease course, extending the period during which an individual can remain infectious while undiagnosed.

p4_macro_symptom_to_diagnosis_lag → p4_macro_detection_coverage_rate intra_scale Longer symptom-to-diagnosis lag lowers the number of new diagnoses per current infectious person-step, reducing detection coverage.
p4_macro_symptom_to_diagnosis_lag → p4_macro_silent_prevalence_share intra_scale Delayed diagnosis leaves more infectious agents undiagnosed, increasing the silent share of current infectious agents.
p4_macro_symptom_to_diagnosis_lag → p4_macro_masking_ratio intra_scale Longer symptom-to-diagnosis lag can leave more ever-exposed agents never diagnosed, increasing the masking ratio.

N24 | p4_micro_silent_infectious_flag Agent silent-infectious indicator Scale: micro | Phenomenon: silent_transmission_masking Definition: Z_i(t) = 1 if infectious_i(t) = true and diagnosed_i(t) = false; 0 if infectious_i(t) = true and diagnosed_i(t) = true; undefined if infectious_i(t) = false or the agent is not observed at t. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N25 | p4_micro_silent_infectious_duration Agent cumulative silent-infectious duration Scale: micro | Phenomenon: silent_transmission_masking Definition: D_i(t) = number of observed steps s <= t in the same run with Z_i(s) = 1; undefined if agent i is not observed at t. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N26 | p4_micro_symptomatic_undiagnosed_flag Agent symptomatic-but-undiagnosed indicator Scale: micro | Phenomenon: silent_transmission_masking Definition: Y_i(t) = 1 if symptomatic_i(t) = true and diagnosed_i(t) = false; 0 if symptomatic_i(t) = true and diagnosed_i(t) = true; undefined if symptomatic_i(t) = false or the agent is not observed. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N27 | p4_meso_group_silent_share Silent share of infectious person-steps by quarantine-status group Scale: meso | Phenomenon: silent_transmission_masking Definition: For group g at step t: q_g(t) = (sum over agents i in g at t of Z_i(t)) / (sum over agents i in g at t of 1[infectious_i(t)]); undefined when the denominator is 0. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N28 | p4_meso_group_exposure_yield_silent Exposures generated per silent infectious person-step by group Scale: meso | Phenomenon: silent_transmission_masking Definition: y_g(t) = (sum over agents i in group g of X_i(t)) / (sum over agents i in group g of Z_i(t)); undefined when the denominator is 0. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N29 | p4_macro_detection_coverage_rate New diagnoses per infectious person-step Scale: macro | Phenomenon: silent_transmission_masking Definition: c(t) = (number of agents with diagnosed transition 1 at step t, i.e. diagnosed_i(t) = true and diagnosed_i(t-1) = false) / (number of agents with infectious_i(t) = true); undefined when the denominator is 0 or t-1 is not observed. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N30 | p4_macro_silent_prevalence_share Silent share of current infectious agents Scale: macro | Phenomenon: silent_transmission_masking Definition: s(t) = (sum over agents i of Z_i(t)) / (sum over agents i of 1[infectious_i(t) = true]); undefined when the denominator is 0. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N31 | p4_macro_masking_ratio Cumulative never-diagnosed to ever-diagnosed infection ratio Scale: macro | Phenomenon: silent_transmission_masking Definition: U(t) = count of agents i with E_i(t) = 1 and no diagnosed_i(s) = true for any observed s <= t, divided by count of agents i with E_i(t) = 1 and at least one diagnosed_i(s) = true for some s <= t; undefined when the denominator is 0. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N32 | p4_macro_symptom_to_diagnosis_lag Mean recorded symptom-to-diagnosis interval Scale: macro | Phenomenon: silent_transmission_masking Definition: L(t) = mean over agents i diagnosed newly at step t, with both date_symptomatic and date_diagnosed non-null, of (date_diagnosed_i - date_symptomatic_i); undefined when no agent qualifies.
